title: Media Product Definition four-phase program
description: Media consumer declaration. Phase order is a dependency graph; each phase retains its own selected obligation and cannot inherit its denominator from a predecessor.

phases.title: Product Truth
phases.description: Product intent, actors, capabilities, requirements, quality policy, and explicit scope decisions.

phases.title: Domain and Data
phases.description: Canonical domain objects, authority, state, transition, operation, data, and projection semantics.

phases.title: Design and Interface System
phases.description: Reusable design language and interface contracts traceable to accepted product and domain meaning.

phases.title: Complete Product Experience
phases.description: Screen, journey, and machine experiences bound to product meaning, domain contracts, and reusable presentation authorities.

metadata.authorityBoundary: Media owns product semantics; Lifecycle owns admission, fingerprints, currentness, evidence, receipts, and closure decisions.
